title: Offline structural validation
summary: The optional Python CLI checks local records and relationships using the standard library. The current record parser accepts duplicate JSON member names. The adopter audit records that validation gap.
acceptance_criteria: Validate without a hosted service or third-party Python package.
Detect malformed schemas, records, and broken references.

evidence.claim: Public Ubuntu and Windows jobs pass the portable structural regression suite.
Lydite reported duplicate-field acceptance, which was also confirmed on the v0.0.2 public validator.
